beforeImage.name: Prospect Power
beforeImage.description: Prospect Power is a standalone battery storage project in Rockingham County, Virginia. The asset is designed to serve grid reliability and wholesale market needs through an asset-heavy storage model rather than retail electricity supply. Public disclosures describe the project as a 150 MW and 600 MWh facility near Northern Virginia's Data Center Alley, with operations expected in 2026. The project is positioned within PJM and reflects the growing role of storage assets in balancing high-load power markets. Elevate Renewables announced in January 2026 that it had acquired Prospect Power from Swift Current Energy, while public sources do not disclose the detailed ownership percentages within ArcLight's platform.

afterImage.name: Prospect Power
afterImage.description: Prospect Power is an operating 150 MW / 600 MWh four-hour standalone battery-energy-storage project in Rockingham County, Virginia, serving PJM and northern Virginia load through a 15-year Dominion Energy Virginia power-purchase arrangement. Swift Current Energy acquired the project from Clean Planet Renewable Energy in 2023 while Swift was controlled by IFM-managed funds. IFM reports that Swift completed the sale to Elevate in December 2025, while January 15, 2026 company releases announced the already-completed transfer. Elevate, an ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VII platform, is the current owner and operator, and the project was operating by June 2026. Prospect Power, LLC and tariff successor Lighthouse Prospect Power, LLC are treated as one project identity; Swift and Elevate are sponsor platforms rather than duplicate PortCos. Public sources do not disclose the exact sale-closing day, project-level ownership percentage or immediate acquisition SPV, and no later sale or signed pending transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
